svg.aria-label: Complete analysis of a constructed teaching spectrum. A compares baseline anchor selections; B separates neighboring contributions; C examines residuals; D compares estimated area ratios with the known value of 0.6. All panels come from the same execution. Model positions are not chemical assignments for an experimental material.
